P.name: Night Hunter
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Vayne''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|30 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}}, increased to {{as|90|ms}} while under the effects of ''{{ai|Final Hour|Vayne}}''.

Q.name: Tumble
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vayne''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the target direction, though not through terrain, and empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 3 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.

W.name: Silver Bolts
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Vayne's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Condemn|Vayne}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Silver Bolts'' for {{fd|3.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, expiring upon attacking a new enemy, and stacking up to 3 times.
W.description2: The third stack consumes them all to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}}, with a minimum threshold.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus True Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 10}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Bonus Damage|{{ap|40 to 100}}}}

E.name: Condemn
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vayne''' fires a heavy bolt at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} 475 units, though not through terrain.
E.description2: If the target collides with [[terrain]], they take {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}|physical}} and become {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{ap|1.5}} seconds.
E.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|50*1.5 to 190*1.5}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|50*2.5 to 190*2.5}} {{as|(+ 125% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

R.name: Final Hour
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vayne''' equips her crossbow, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} for a duration.
R.leveling:
{{st|Effect Duration|{{ap|8 to 12}} seconds}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|35 to 65 3}}}}
R.description2: While active, ''Final Hour'' empowers ''{{ai|Night Hunter|Vayne}}'' to have tripled {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} and ''{{ai|Tumble|Vayne}}'' to have a reduced {{sti|cooldown}}. Additionally, ''{{ais|Tumble|Vayne}}'' cast grants '''Vayne''' {{tip|invisibility}} for 1 second. Attacking or casting abilities ends the stealth immediately.
R.description3: Scoring an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will extend ''Final Hour's'' duration by 4 seconds, up to its original duration.
